text:
8. 1. 2. 8. 

Itthibandhana suttaṃ. 

(Sāvatthi nidānaṃ)

Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi puriso itthiṃ bandhati, katamehi aṭṭhahi:

Rūpena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati, hasitena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Bhaṇitena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Gītena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Ruṇṇena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Ākappena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Vanabhaṅgena bhikkhave, puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Phassena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi ākārehi puriso itthiṃ bandhati, te bhikkhave sattā subaddhā ye phassena baddhāti. 3*
